description: Ex-9 Squadron Royal Jordanian Air Force F-104A at Jordan University of Science and Technology between Irbid and Ramtha, coded N. Construction number 183-1133, ex USAF 56-845. Spottingmode and the International F-104 Society agree on the identity, although the F-104 society's entry still asks for confirmation of the precise site. Latest Esri tile for the point is 13 February 2022.
museum_name: Jordan University of Science and Technology
